summary: Configured and verified a reboot-persistent OpenTelemetry Collector deployment across node1–node3. The node1 HTTPS gateway enforces client mTLS, routes payments only to node2 and inventory only to node3 over mTLS, rejects invalid namespaces, and retains traces exactly once in the required files.
actions_performed: Generated node-local TLS keys and exchanged only public trust certificates.
Created the client credential bundle under /root/otel-client on node1.
Configured synchronous, no-retry namespace routing and pre-routing validation on node1.
Configured append-only JSON retention with namespace safeguards on node2 and node3.
Tested valid, missing, unsupported, mixed-validity, and unauthenticated requests.
Restarted node2, node3, then node1 individually and verified changed boot identities, service recovery, retained data, and post-restart routing.

evidence.requirement: HTTPS OTLP/HTTP gateway, routing configuration, and client credentials
evidence.summary: Configuration validates; node1 listens on 4318, requires a client CA, has exact routing conditions, disables queues/retries, and retains a verified root-owned client bundle.

evidence.requirement: Payments route only to node2; inventory route only to node3; no duplicate delivery
evidence.summary: Accepted requests returned HTTP 200. Final files contain three expected trace IDs exactly once each and zero trace IDs belonging to the other namespace.

evidence.requirement: Missing and unsupported namespaces are rejected without partial delivery
evidence.summary: Missing, unsupported, and mixed-validity requests returned HTTP 503; rejected trace IDs are absent from both files, including after restarts.
Certificate identities and matching trust fingerprints were verified. Both backend collectors reject connections without client certificates, while authenticated gateway forwarding succeeds.
Current healthy state shows /var/lib/otel/payments.json on node2 and /var/lib/otel/inventory.json on node3, each with three retained JSON records and correct ownership.
Boot ID changed from 28ae5f98-80ff-424c-9f6f-523320557628 to 28f1911d-d40c-4fc0-b43e-830444907c13. The gateway, credentials, routing, mTLS enforcement, acceptance, and rejection behavior recovered.
